title: Wings rehearse in Nashville | 1974
content:
Wings rehearsed in Nashville, Tennessee, on 12 June 1974.

The rehearsals took place at the farm owned by songwriter Claude ‘Curly’ Putman Jr. Wings stayed at the farm, which they rented for $2,000 a week, and rehearsed in the garage.

On this and the previous day, Wings primarily worked on the songs ‘Jet’ and ‘Band On The Run’.

Also on this day, drummer Geoff Britton had an x-ray on his right foot at a local hospital. He had broken it while karate training on 3 June, but resisted having a cast fitted in case it interfered with his playing. Instead he bought some stiff new shoes in the hope that they would help him heal. He did not inform the rest of the band of his issues at this time.

After the rehearsal, Paul McCartney, Denny Laine, and Britton jammed before watching television together. Guitarist Jimmy McCulloch, the heaviest drinker in the band, went out to the local bars.
